_help: Source for /resume/ (public page), the Experience section of the home page in hire mode, and `node scripts/build-site.mjs --pdf` (private PDF). Anything under "private" never appears on the site as readable text: the clearance badge and summary are stored encoded, here too (each value is "enc:" followed by the output of `node scripts/build-site.mjs --encode 'the text'`), and only shown when the address carries ?cleared (an unlisted link to hand out, not a secret); it only reaches the locally generated PDF, merged with content/private.json (git-ignored) for the phone number.

projects.title: Enter Space
projects.text: Enter Space brings all your cloud storage together into a single, unified app. Easily organize your files, favorite your most-used nested folders for quick access, and seamlessly sync your data across all of your devices using iCloud. Whether you are managing important documents or exploring your personal library, Enter Space provides a smooth and responsive experience.

projects.title: Haven
projects.text: Haven is a private, end-to-end encrypted social network designed for your closest friends and family. It operates without ads, tracking, or subscriptions, ensuring that your shared memories and messages travel directly between devices using post-quantum cryptography. With features like silent post updates and offline sharing, Haven offers a secure, algorithm-free space to connect with the people who matter most.
